title: From Accuracy to Auditability: A Survey of Determinism in Financial AI Systems
abstract: arXiv:2605.23955v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deploying machine learning in regulated financial environments -- credit risk, fraud detection, and anti-money laundering -- exposes critical vulnerabilities in algorithmic reproducibility. While early financial ML addressed statistical challenges such as backtest overfitting, deep neural networks and Generative AI have introduced mechanical nondeterminism rooted in hardware and architecture. This survey provides a systems perspective on reproducibility failures across three modalities now dominant in financial AI: tabular models (post-hoc explanation variance), graph networks (stochastic sampling and temporal asynchrony), and LLM-based agentic workflows (batch-dependent divergence and trajectory drift). translated_title: 从准确性到可审计性：金融AI系统确定性综述
translated_abstract: 在受监管的金融环境中部署机器学习——如信用风险、欺诈检测和反洗钱——暴露了算法可复现性中的关键脆弱性。尽管早期金融机器学习解决了回测过拟合等统计挑战，但深度神经网络和生成式AI引入了根源于硬件和架构的机械性非确定性。本综述从系统视角审视了当前金融AI中主导的三种模态下的复现性失败：表格模型（事后解释方差）、图网络（随机采样和时间异步性），以及基于LLM的智能体工作流（批次依赖的差异和轨迹漂移）。我们通过公开金融数据集上的第一方实验补充了文献分析——量化了信用评分中的解释排名不稳定性、基于GNN的欺诈检测中的预测翻转率，以及张量并行中的（此处原文截断）。
tldr: 该综述系统性地分析了金融AI系统中从表格模型到图网络再到LLM智能体的三类非确定性来源，并通过公开数据实验量化了复现性失败，为可审计金融AI提供了系统视角。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically analyzes three sources of nondeterminism in financial AI systems—from tabular models to graph networks to LLM-based agents—and quantifies reproducibility failures through public-data experiments, offering a systems perspective for auditable financial AI.
